prompt: Quiero que ___ más despacio. (I want you to speak more slowly.) [hablar, tú]
It is important that we eat well. → Es importante que ___ bien.
No creo que ___ razón. (I don't think he's right.) [tener, él]
hint: Tener: yo = tengo → drop -o → teng- + a (subjunctive).

prompt: I hope the weather is nice. → Ojalá ___ buen tiempo.
hint: Ojalá always triggers the subjunctive. Hacer: hago → hag- + a.

prompt: Espero que ___ a la fiesta. (I hope you come to the party.) [venir, tú]
hint: Venir: yo = vengo → drop -o → veng- + as (tú subjunctive).
